title: 第6章 收服黑木蚁群第7章 蚁后的忧愁
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
黑木蚁群，是一个和孙云蚁群不远的蚁群，她们规模和孙云所在的蚁群差不多。但领地潮湿，虫类众多，更适合狩猎。
因为都想壮大，所以蚁群都在尽量的多生幼蚁，随着数量的增加，自然为了抢夺食物和地盘摩擦不断。长年累月，自然征战不断，死伤在所难免，使得双方蚁群都受到了数量限制。
这种微妙的平衡，自从孙云出现，渐渐的开始打破了。孙云现在，虽然没有各个将军的体型，但却有将军的实力。
他经过几个月的锻炼，无论力量、速度和耐力，都不是其他将军能比的。再加上，有超越团长实力的黑头几个蚁兵，还有大量的精英蚁兵，更是如虎添翼！
孙云的成长，让蚁后信心倍增，就他这两百多蚁，就有一个军团的实力了。竟然有了实力，蚁后又想要再壮大蚁族，自然而然的打起了黑木蚁群的主意。
这重任，自然落到风头正劲的孙云头上，也是在验证他训练成果。
……
经过，黑头一段时间的侦察，发现黑木蚁群的战斗蚁部队，会定时出去捕食，短时间赶不回来。
又经过几位高层蚁的商议，确定是一个难得的好机会，所以蚁后便决定，执行吞并掉黑木蚁群行动！
孙云先带雷霆战队的队员，在水中潜入对方的领地，并通过路边的草丛，埋伏在蚁穴附近。蚁族天生惧水，更少有蚁到这附近巡查，给孙云制造了机会！
“杀啊，兄弟们冲啊！”
突然一片喊杀声，打破了此时的宁静。红头将军，带着大量的蚂蚁，冲向黑木蚁群的巢穴。顿时，黑木蚁群大量的蚂蚁，被偷袭死在巨鄂下。
黑木蚁群的兵蚁，急忙集合迎战，但根本抵挡不住红头的队伍。因为时间仓促，战斗蚁又在外面捕食没回来，几个回合下来，就死伤惨重！
“冲！”
等对方的守卫蚁，都跑去迎敌了，孙云带着雷霆战队冲入蚁穴。普通的蚁，根本就阻挡不了雷霆战队的步伐，孙云带蚁横冲直撞，丝毫没有停滞，简直是单方面的屠杀。
没用多长时间，孙云的雷霆战队，就冲到黑木蚁后的住处。黑木蚁后的护卫块头大，雷霆战队确丝毫不差，经过野外生存的残酷训练，雷霆的战力根本不是养尊处优的蚁后护卫能比的！
啪……嘎吱…咯吱……
蚁穴里充满了厮打与啃嚼，双方的实力相差不大，一时到也难分胜负。雷霆战队配合默契，黑木护卫加上后来退回来的蚁兵，数量庞大。但仍旧，还有几个实力强大的几个护卫没有动，它们要保护蚁后安全。
孙云暗暗心急，得赶快结束战斗，拖时间太长了，会很危险的。黑木蚁群的战斗军团，很快就能赶回来，如果他们也冲进来，这次就算成功了，自己的这些兄弟也很难逃出多少。
“上！”

孙云带着五十实力比较强的手下，直接爬上洞顶，向蚁后潜伏过去。蚂蚁虽然会爬墙，但没有蚁闲着没事去爬洞顶，但孙云自然要发挥这项特长，对雷霆战队进行了严格的训练。所以，这对雷霆战队来说，如同走平地，可见平时的攀爬训练没白练。
当然，也有大量的黑木蚁护卫，过来拦截他们。可是，怎么可能是身手灵活的雷霆战队的对手，纷纷被击落下去。在洞顶战斗，对于雷霆战队来说如同平地，黑木蚁群的护卫，就像下雨一样，被孙云等蚁屠杀以下来，几乎没有一招之敌。
“杀！”
五十蚁的雷霆小队，很快爬到黑木蚁后的头顶，孙云一声令下，几乎同时向黑木蚁后落去，巨鄂张嘴便咬，丝毫没有落地时的停顿。
吱吱……
黑木蚁后，哪见过这种攻击，还没反应过来，巨大的身上就咬满了蚂蚁。蚁后因为生产幼蚁，身体本来就肥硕，防卸也没有兵蚁强。
虽然，她实力比孙云还强大，但面对绝对的数量，还不幸的被敌人扑到身上。面对雷霆小队闪电般凶狠的攻击，黑木蚁后绝望了。
等黑木蚁后的护卫冲上来，从蚁堆里把蚁后救出来，黑木蚁后已经没救了。腿已经断完了，脖子都快咬断了，可见雷霆小队攻击的多迅猛。没有多长时间，黑木蚁后就烟气了。
下面的护卫见蚁后已死，没有了保护对象，顿时树倒猢狲散，都四散而逃了。只剩下十几个蚁后的死忠，保护蚁后的尸体！
孙云直接冲向黑木的护卫统领，张嘴便咬，对方也毫不示弱，顿时两蚁撕咬在一起。黑头和牛在旁边压阵，孙云这样做，也是避免雷霆战队再有死伤，毕竟黑木的护卫统领太强大。其他十几个黑木护卫，也遭到雷霆战队的围攻，显然败局已定！
很快孙云提着黑木统领和蚁后的蚁头，出现在蚁穴外！没有了蚁后的黑木蚁群，很快要么臣服，要么被屠杀，很快被收服！
黑木蚁群的战斗军蚁赶回来救援，明智的选择了臣服，毕竟没有新兵补充的兵蚁，再强大也难逃灭绝的命运。
这次的收服，可谓改变了蚁群的未来，让孙云这个蚁群，一越成为附近最大的几个族群之一。尤其是统领的地盘，巨大的狩猎场地，够养活再壮大几倍的蚁群了。
孙云这次，也牺牲了几十个战友，当然也受到了蚁后的奖赏。不但，让孙云任意挑选幼蚁八千名，还赏了一些食物，使孙云成功的培养新生力量。而且，还给孙云团长的职务，独立于三打军团之外，只受蚁后调遣。
孙云让一些重伤难以康复的战士，负责训练新兵，享受与战斗兵种一样的待遇。这让雷霆战队的成员更加有信心，最起码不用担心，残疾了被抛弃或扔在一个洞穴等死的命运。
大量的幼蚁，都很努力的表现自己，希望能加入雷霆的训练。只要能被选中，就算最后没能坚持到最后，只要在雷霆训练过的，都成为各大军团争抢的对象。
在雷霆出来的，不但体格强壮，军事素养也高，无论作战和成活率，都不是其他幼蚁能比的。
content_en:
The Blackwood Ant Colony is an ant colony not far from the Sun Yun Ant Colony. Their size is similar to the ant colony where Sun Yun is located. But the territory is humid and full of insects, making it more suitable for hunting.
Because they all want to grow, the ant colonies are trying to give birth to as many young ants as possible. As the number increases, there will naturally be constant friction for food and territory. Over the years, natural battles have continued, and casualties are inevitable, which has limited the number of ant colonies on both sides.
This delicate balance has gradually begun to break since Sun Yun appeared. Now, although Sun Yun does not have the size of various generals, he has the strength of generals.
After months of training, his strength, speed and endurance are unmatched by other generals. In addition, there are several black-headed ant soldiers whose strength exceeds that of the leader, as well as a large number of elite ant soldiers, which is even more powerful!
Sun Yun's growth has doubled the queen's confidence. With just over two hundred ants, he has the strength of an army. Now that she had gained strength, the queen ant wanted to grow the ant clan again, so she naturally came up with the idea of ​​forming a black wood ant colony.
This important task naturally fell on Sun Yun, who was in the limelight, and it was also to verify his training results.
…
After a period of reconnaissance by Blackhead, he discovered that the fighting ant troops of the Blackwood Ant colony would go out to hunt for food regularly and would not be able to come back in a short time.
After discussions with several high-level ants, it was determined that this was a rare opportunity, so the queen decided to annex the Blackwood Ant Colony!
Sun Yun first led the members of the Thunder Team to sneak into the opponent's territory in the water, and passed through the grass on the roadside to ambush near the ant nest. The ants are naturally afraid of water, so fewer ants patrol the area, creating an opportunity for Sun Yun!
"Kill, brothers, charge!"
Suddenly a cry of death broke the tranquility at this time. The red-headed general, with a large number of ants, rushed towards the nest of the black wood ant colony. Suddenly, a large number of ants in the black wood ant colony were attacked and died under the giant jaw.
The soldier ants of the black wood ant colony hurriedly gathered to fight, but they were unable to resist the red-headed team. Because time was short, the fighting ants were hunting outside and did not come back. After a few rounds, they suffered heavy casualties!
"Charge!"
When the opponent's guard ants all ran to meet the enemy, Sun Yun led the Thunder Team into the ant nest. Ordinary ants couldn't stop the Thunder Team at all. Sun Yun led the ants on a rampage without stopping at all. It was a one-sided massacre.
It didn't take long for Sun Yun's Thunder Team to rush to the Blackwood Ant Queen's residence. The guards of the Blackwood Ant Queen are big, and the Thunder Team is indeed no worse. After brutal training in survival in the wild, the combat power of Thunder cannot be compared to that of the pampered Queen Ant Guards!
Snap...crunch...crunch...
The ant nest was full of fighting and gnawing. There was not much difference in strength between the two sides, and it was difficult to tell the winner at the last moment. The Thunder team cooperated tacitly, and the blackwood guards and the ant soldiers who later returned were huge in number. But still, there are still a few powerful guards who have not moved. They want to protect the safety of the queen ant.
Sun Yun was secretly anxious and had to end the battle quickly. If it took too long, it would be very dangerous. The fighting legion of the Blackwood Ant Colony will be back soon. If they rush in too, even if they succeed this time, it will be difficult for these brothers of mine to escape.
"Up!"
Sun Yun led fifty of his stronger men, climbed directly to the top of the cave, and lurked towards the ant queen. Although ants can climb walls, no ants have time to climb to the top of a cave. However, Sun Yun naturally wanted to use this skill and conducted rigorous training for Team Thunder. Therefore, for the Thunder team, this is like walking on flat ground, which shows that the usual climbing training is not in vain.
Of course, there were also a large number of black carpenter ant guards coming to intercept them. However, how could it be that the opponents of the agile Thunder Team were shot down one after another. Fighting on the roof of the cave was like flat ground to the Thunder Team. The guards of the Blackwood Ant Group were massacred by Sun Yun and other ants like rain., there is almost no enemy with one move.
"Kill!"
The thunder squad of fifty ants quickly climbed to the top of the Black Wood Ant Queen. Sun Yun gave the order and fell to the Black Wood Ant Queen almost simultaneously. The giant jaw opened its mouth and bit without any pause when it landed.
Zhizhi...
The black wood ant queen had never seen such an attack before. Before she could react, her huge body was covered with ants. Because the queen ant gives birth to young ants, her body is already fat, and her defense is not as strong as that of the soldier ants.
Although she was stronger than Sun Yun, in the face of sheer numbers, she was unfortunately jumped by the enemy. Facing the lightning-like and ferocious attack of the Thunder Team, the Black Wood Ant Queen was desperate.
When the guards of the Black Wood Ant Queen rushed up and rescued the Queen from the ant pile, the Black Wood Ant Queen was already hopeless. The legs were completely broken and the neck was almost bitten off, which shows how fast the Thunder Team attacked. It didn't take long for the black wood ant queen to smoke.
When the guards below saw that the queen ant was dead and had no one to protect, they immediately fell down and fled in all directions. There are only a dozen die-hard loyalists left to protect the queen's corpse!
Sun Yun rushed directly to Heimu's guard leader, opened his mouth and bit him, but the other party showed no sign of weakness, and the two ants immediately bit each other. Heitou and Niu were holding the battle next to them. Sun Yun did this to avoid further casualties in the Thunder Team. After all, Heimu's guard commander was too powerful. A dozen other Blackwood guards were also besieged by the Thunder Team, and their defeat was obviously decided!
Soon Sun Yun appeared outside the ant nest carrying the ant heads of Commander Blackwood and the Queen! Without the queen, the black wood ant colony will soon either surrender or be slaughtered, and will soon be conquered!
The fighting army ants of the Blackwood Ant Colony rushed back to rescue them and wisely chose to surrender. After all, without the recruitment of new soldiers, no matter how powerful the soldier ants are, they cannot escape the fate of extinction.
This conquest can be said to have changed the future of the ant colony, making Sun Yun's ant colony one of the largest groups in the vicinity. Especially the leader's territory, a huge hunting ground, is enough to support an ant colony that can grow several times larger.
Sun Yun also sacrificed dozens of his comrades this time, and of course he was rewarded by the Queen Ant. Not only did Sun Yun be allowed to choose 8,000 young ants at will, he was also rewarded with some food, allowing Sun Yun to successfully cultivate new forces. Moreover, the position given to Sun Yun as commander is independent of the three dozen legions and is only subject to the dispatch of the Queen Ant.
Sun Yun asked some soldiers who were seriously injured and difficult to recover to be responsible for training new recruits and enjoy the same treatment as combat troops. This makes the members of the Thunder Team more confident. At least they don't have to worry about the fate of being abandoned or thrown into a cave to die.
A large number of young ants are working hard to express themselves, hoping to join Thunder's training. As long as they can be selected, even if they fail to persist to the end, as long as they have been trained in Thunder, they will become the targets of competition among the major legions.
Those who come out of Thunder are not only physically strong, but also have high military qualities. In terms of combat and survival rate, they are unmatched by other young ants.
